title: Retainers for recurring client fees
summary: Bill clients a fixed fee on a schedule.

steps.text: Open {nav} from the sidebar to see every retainer and its status.
Choose {new} to set one up: the client, the fee lines and how often it is billed.
Choose {gen} to bill every retainer that is due now.
You can also ask the assistant to generate the retainer invoices that are due, bill one early or skip a period. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
